.j-layout-bento,
.j-layout-cols-3,

.j-layout-bento .j-media-wrapper,

  height: 100%;
  align-items: center;

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;

  font-size: 1rem;

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

  // 1. SÉCURITÉ : Vérifie que GSAP est chargé
  if (typeof gsap === "undefined") return;

  // 2. SÉLECTION OU CRÉATION DU RIDEAU
  let curtain = document.querySelector('.j-transition-curtain');
  if (!curtain) {
    curtain = document.createElement('div');
    curtain.className = 'j-transition-curtain';
    document.body.appendChild(curtain);
  }

  const mainContent = document.querySelector('.j-work-page-wrapper, .j-project-page-wrapper');

  const currentPath = window.location.pathname;
  const isProjectPage = currentPath.includes('/nos-projets/');

  // ========================================================================
  // 3. ANIMATION D'ENTRÉE (Le rideau monte pour révéler la page)
  // ========================================================================
  if (isProjectPage) {
    gsap.set(curtain, {
      display: "block",
      visibility: "visible",
      yPercent: 0,
      pointerEvents: "all"
    });

    gsap.to(curtain, {
      yPercent: -101,
      duration: 1.2,
      ease: "expo.inOut",
      delay: 0.1,
      onComplete: () => {
        gsap.set(curtain, {
          display: "none",
          visibility: "hidden",
          pointerEvents: "none"
        });
      }
    });

    if (mainContent) {
      gsap.fromTo(mainContent,
        { scale: 0.95, opacity: 0, filter: "blur(4px)" },
        {
          scale: 1,
          opacity: 1,
          filter: "blur(0px)",
          duration: 1.2,
          ease: "expo.out",
          delay: 0.4,
          clearProps: "all"
        }
      );
    }
  } else {
    gsap.set(curtain, { display: "none", visibility: "hidden" });
  }

  // ========================================================================
  // 4. ANIMATION DE SORTIE (Le rideau monte pour couvrir la page actuelle)
  // ========================================================================
  // ⚠️ MODIFIÉ 03/09/2026 : `^=` (commence par) → `*=` (contient).
  // Le sélecteur de langue plus bas réécrit ces liens en /en/nos-projets/…
  // sur les pages anglaises ; avec `^=` le sélecteur ne matchait plus rien
  // et la transition mourait en silence sur tout le site anglais.
  const transitionLinks = document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/nos-projets/"]');

  transitionLinks.forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {

      if (this.getAttribute("target") === "_blank" || this.getAttribute("href").includes("#")) return;

      e.preventDefault();
      const targetUrl = this.getAttribute("href");

      gsap.set(curtain, {
        display: "block",
        visibility: "visible",
        yPercent: 100,
        pointerEvents: "all"
      });

      if (mainContent) {
        gsap.to(mainContent, {
          scale: 0.95,
          opacity: 0.5,
          filter: "blur(4px)",
          duration: 1,
          ease: "expo.inOut"
        });
      }

      gsap.to(curtain, {
        yPercent: 0,
        duration: 1,
        ease: "expo.inOut",
        onComplete: () => {
          window.location.href = targetUrl;
        }
      });
    });
  });

  // ========================================================================
  // 5. FIX BACK BUTTON
  // ========================================================================
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', (event) => {
    if (event.persisted) {
      gsap.set(curtain, { display: "none", visibility: "hidden" });
      if (mainContent) gsap.set(mainContent, { clearProps: "all" });
    }
  });
});

(function () {

  var path = location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "") || "/";
  var isEN = path === "/en" || path.indexOf("/en/") === 0;
  var queue = location.search + location.hash;
  var urlFR = isEN ? (path.replace(/^\/en/, "") || "/") : path;
  var urlEN = isEN ? path : "/en" + (path === "/" ? "" : path);

  function build(variante) {
    var box = document.createElement("div");
    box.className = "ms-lang ms-lang--" + variante;
    box.setAttribute("role", "group");
    box.setAttribute("aria-label", isEN ? "Language" : "Langue");

    var thumb = document.createElement("span");
    thumb.className = "ms-lang__thumb";
    thumb.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
    thumb.style.transform = "translateX(" + (isEN ? 38 : 0) + "px)";
    box.appendChild(thumb);

    [["FR", urlFR, "fr", !isEN], ["EN", urlEN, "en", isEN]].forEach(function (l) {
      var a = document.createElement("a");
      a.className = "ms-lang__link";
      a.href = l[1] + queue;
      a.textContent = l[0];
      a.lang = l[2];
      a.hreflang = l[2];
      a.setAttribute("data-ms-lang", "1");
      if (l[3]) a.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
      box.appendChild(a);
    });
    return box;
  }

  // Desktop : attaché à la barre entière, pas à .j-header-classic-right qui,
  // malgré son nom, s'arrête au milieu de l'écran. Masqué dès que la nav
  // desktop disparaît — on se fie à son état réel, pas à un point de rupture.
  var barre = document.querySelector(".j-header-classic");
  var navDesktop = document.querySelector(".j-header-classic-right");
  if (barre && navDesktop) {
    var deskt = build("desktop");
    barre.appendChild(deskt);
    var sync = function () {
      deskt.style.display =
        getComputedStyle(navDesktop).display === "none" ? "none" : "inline-flex";
    };
    sync();
    window.addEventListener("resize", sync);
  }

  // Mobile : dans le panneau du menu, et nulle part ailleurs.
  var menu = document.querySelector(".j-mega-menu-main .j-menu-links-wrapper");
  if (menu) menu.appendChild(build("menu"));

  // Rattrapage des liens internes non localisés (filet côté navigateur ;

  if (isEN) {
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="/"]').forEach(function (a) {
      if (a.hasAttribute("data-ms-lang")) return;
      var h = a.getAttribute("href");
      if (h.indexOf("//") === 0) return;
      if (h === "/en" || h.indexOf("/en/") === 0) return;
      a.setAttribute("href", "/en" + (h === "/" ? "" : h));
    });
  }

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  
  // 🚨 SECURITÉ : On vérifie que GSAP est bien chargé avant de lancer quoi que ce soit
  if (typeof gsap === "undefined") {
    console.warn("GSAP n'est pas chargé. Vérifie tes liens CDN !");
    return;
  }

  // Enregistrement des plugins
  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  // 1. SÉLECTEURS existants (ton code précédent)
  const sections = document.querySelectorAll('.j-project-section[data-section-id]');
  const navHeaders = document.querySelectorAll('.j-accordion-header[data-nav-id]');
  const mobileLabel = document.getElementById('mobile-category-label');
  const bottomBar = document.querySelector('[data-js="bottom-bar"]');
  const mobileOverlay = document.querySelector('[data-js="mobile-overlay"]');
  const mobileToggles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-js="mobile-toggle"]');
  const kpiNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.j-kpi-number[data-kpi-target]');

  // 2. LOGIQUE ACCORDÉON (ton code précédent)
  const accordions = Array.from(navHeaders).map(header => {
    return {
      id: header.getAttribute('data-nav-id'),
      item: header.closest('.j-accordion-item'),
      content: header.nextElementSibling,
      title: header.querySelector('.j-accordion-title') ? header.querySelector('.j-accordion-title').textContent : ""
    };
  });

  function updateUI(activeId) {
    let activeTitle = "";
    accordions.forEach(acc => {
      if (acc.id === activeId) {
        acc.item.classList.add('is-active');
        if (acc.content) acc.content.style.height = acc.content.scrollHeight + "px";
        activeTitle = acc.title;
      } else {
        acc.item.classList.remove('is-active');
        if (acc.content) acc.content.style.height = "0px";
      }
    });
    if (mobileLabel && activeTitle !== "") mobileLabel.textContent = activeTitle;
  }

  if (accordions.length > 0 && window.scrollY < 100) {
    updateUI(accordions[0].id);
  }

  // 3. SCROLL SPY
  const spyOptions = { root: null, rootMargin: '-40% 0px -40% 0px', threshold: 0 };
  const sectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        const id = entry.target.getAttribute('data-section-id');
        if (id && id.trim() !== "") updateUI(id);
      }
    });
  }, spyOptions);

  sections.forEach(section => sectionObserver.observe(section));

  // 4. CLIC ACCORDÉON
  accordions.forEach(acc => {
    acc.item.querySelector('.j-accordion-header').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const targetSection = document.querySelector(`.j-project-section[data-section-id="${acc.id}"]`);
      if (targetSection) {
        if (mobileOverlay && mobileOverlay.classList.contains('is-open')) toggleMobileOverlay(false);
        targetSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
      } else {
        updateUI(acc.id);
      }
    });
  });

  // 5. BOTTOM BAR MOBILE
  function handleBottomBarVisibility() {
    if (!bottomBar || window.innerWidth > 991) return;
    if (window.scrollY > 150) {
      bottomBar.classList.add('is-visible');
    } else {
      bottomBar.classList.remove('is-visible');
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', handleBottomBarVisibility, { passive: true });

  function toggleMobileOverlay(forceState = null) {
    if (!mobileOverlay) return;
    const isCurrentlyOpen = mobileOverlay.classList.contains('is-open');
    const shouldOpen = forceState !== null ? forceState : !isCurrentlyOpen;
    if (shouldOpen) {
      mobileOverlay.classList.add('is-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    } else {
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('is-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }
  }

  mobileToggles.forEach(toggle => {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleMobileOverlay();
    });
  });

  // 6. ANIMATION KPI
  if (kpiNumbers.length > 0) {
    const kpiObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateKPI(entry.target);
          obs.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    kpiNumbers.forEach(num => {
      num.textContent = "0";
      kpiObserver.observe(num);
    });

    function animateKPI(el) {
      const targetVal = parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-kpi-target'));
      if (isNaN(targetVal)) return;
      gsap.to(el, {
        innerText: targetVal,
        duration: 2,
        snap: { innerText: 1 },
        ease: "power4.out"
      });
    }
  }

  // 7. NEXT PROJECT REVEAL (STYLE KOTO)
  const nextWrapper = document.querySelector('.j-next-project-wrapper');
  if (nextWrapper) {
    const nextImageLink = nextWrapper.querySelector('.j-next-image-link');
    const nextTexts = nextWrapper.querySelectorAll('.j-next-label, .j-next-link, .j-next-cta-box');
    
    const isDesktop = window.innerWidth > 991;

    gsap.fromTo(nextImageLink, 
      { scale: 0, opacity: 0 },
      {
        scale: 1,
        opacity: 1,
        duration: 1.4,
        ease: "expo.out",
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: nextWrapper,
          start: "top 85%"
        }
      }
    );

    gsap.from(nextTexts, {
      y: 30,
      opacity: 0,
      duration: 1,
      stagger: 0.1,
      ease: "power3.out",
      scrollTrigger: {
        trigger: nextWrapper,
        start: "top 80%"
      }
    });
  }

  // 8. RESIZE FIX
  let resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      const activeAcc = accordions.find(a => a.item.classList.contains('is-active'));
      if (activeAcc && activeAcc.content) {
        activeAcc.content.style.height = activeAcc.content.scrollHeight + "px";
      }
    }, 150);
  });

});
